Dubai’s dynamic economy is always changing, which makes some skill sets and occupations more in demand. When examining the employment market, a few positions stand out as being in high demand.

Additionally, the city’s reputation as a tourist destination means that there are many job opportunities in the hospitality and tourism industry.
